title: Quick Tip: Business Central Update 27.3 – What’s New
summary: Update 27.3 for Dynamics 365 Business Central introduces enhancements to the Payables Agent for invoice processing, expands regional availability, and adds compliance features for Spain and US tax forms. This incremental update is part of the 2025 release wave 2.
key_points: Payables Agent now matches purchase invoices to orders intelligently and shows confidence scores to prioritize review work
Payables Agent expands to more countries and regions for broader adoption
New compliance support includes Spain's Verifactu requirements and bulk printing of US IRS 1099 forms
Update includes various bug fixes and technical improvements across application and platform layers
features: Match purchase invoices to orders with Payables Agent
Prioritize invoice draft changes using Payables Agent confidence level

quotes.text: By exposing a confidence score, users can focus their attention on invoices that need review, instead of manually checking every draft.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates how Copilot provides decision support through confidence levels to prioritize work
